name: mente-apex
description: Mente Apex private utilities — client onboarding, a brand-book-first client-deliverable generator (offers, proposals, agreements, licences, DPAs, handovers, update briefs — rendered to on-brand HTML/PDF from Markdown), an invoice generator, a one-step ship (branch/commit/push/PR) workflow, a clean-code review/writing standard, a SOLID analysis & guided-refactor workflow, a GoF design-pattern analysis & guided-refactor workflow (creational/structural/behavioral), a TDD (red-green-refactor) implementation workflow with feature and legacy-code modes, plus Claude config sync across machines via Git, plus a Domain-Driven Design modelling/build/analysis workflow (/ddd), a Clean Architecture component/dependency audit (/clean-architecture), a test-suite quality audit (/test-quality: structure, craft, mocking strategy, and stale-test tending), and an umbrella full-audit (/code-quality) that runs all six review lenses at once and merges them into one deduplicated report, and a release pipeline (/release: gate, stamp, build, tag, publish, verify-install) driven by per-technology adapters.
